description: ASP.NET Core 10.0 Clean Architecture API - Fitness/Coaching Platform
business_rules_to_implement: Only coaches can create training programs
Only admins can manage coaches and packages
Payment must be completed before accessing assigned program
Users in waiting queue expire after 30 days
Training program versions increment on updates

notes.architecture: Clean Architecture with 4 layers (Api, Application, Domain, Infrastructure)
notes.database: PostgreSQL via EF Core, using DbContext
notes.patterns: Factory methods for entity creation, private setters for encapsulation
notes.code_style: C# 12+ (implicit usings, nullable reference types, primary constructors)
